set.body: PRD APP-9..APP-11. Delivered on local main: deterministic study preparation, bounded comparison/reduction, FS2 study/recording/temporal runners, progress/outcome contracts, published execution laws and isolated headless consumer evidence (X1 and X3-X6, UI-G1). Remaining acceptance: resolve bd-01M2S5AX3E1E3PRGS3CR322HAX and qualify realistic recording responsiveness against the declared 100 ms target on a pinned runtime. Preserve pure-run equivalence, monotone segment work with explicit Exact/AtMost/Unknown totals, one committed terminal outcome, cancellation with no partial result, and observer/resource cleanup. Record maximum step, runner gap and cancellation latency separately; report workload/runtime/revision and unsupported or unqualified envelopes. docs/EXECUTION_RESPONSIVENESS.md is the measurement contract. X2 remains conditional on consumer demand beyond the measured grid/kernel envelope, not an unconditional prerequisite. No portable real-time guarantee is implied by a passing measurement.
